newsitem.title: FINLAND: Rauma sees steady profitability in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Rauma sees steady profitability in 1997.

text.p: Finnish engineering group Rauma Oy said on Tuesday its order backlog provided it with a solid footing and that profitability would be steady this year.
"The order backlog for Rauma's business groups, as well as the order volume during the last months of 1996, provide a fairly solid footing for 1997," Rauma said in a statement with its 1996 results.
The group's end-1996 order backlog was 3.81 billion markka, down from 4.37 billion one year earlier.
"The board expects Rauma's profitability to be stable during the current year," it said.
Rauma earlier reported 1996 profit after financial items up 1.2 percent at 679 million markka. Group net sales rose 3.9 percent to 10.22 billion markka.
